access.allow: Approve button on a request card in the chat, for a socio (AI agent) that asks to read a mini app for the person.
access.allowForTask: Approve button on a request card in the chat when a socio (AI agent) asks to change data or act in a mini app: the access lasts for this one task.
access.facts.app: Label in a small fact list on a request card: the mini app's name.
access.facts.address: Label in a small fact list on a request card: the mini app's web address (origin).
access.facts.owner: Label in a small fact list on a request card: the person who made the mini app.
access.says: Caption above a quote of a socio's (AI agent's) own words. {{who}} is the socio's name.
access.minutes: How long the requested access lasts, in minutes.
access.hours: How long the requested access lasts, in whole hours.
access.wants: First line of a request card in the chat. {{socio}} is the socio's (AI agent's) name, {{verb}} one of access.verb, {{app}} the mini app's name, {{duration}} access.minutes or access.hours. Keep the tags around the same words.
access.letsIt: Lead-in to a bulleted list of what the access allows (the list itself comes from the server).
access.visibleTo: {{socio}} is the socio's (AI agent's) name, {{place}} the shared chat or room whose members can read its answers.
access.development: Warning on a request card when the mini app runs on the socio's own computer (a development app).
access.widens: Note on a request card: allowing replaces a narrower access already granted in this chat.
access.alwaysAsk: Note on a request card: this mini app never lets a socio act without asking.
action.operation: First line of a card where a socio (AI agent) asks to run a Socio data operation. {{socio}}: the socio's name; {{words}}: the operation in words, such as "delete 3 rows"; {{app}}: the mini app; {{op}}: the operation's technical name (code). "Consequential" is a badge: the action has effects.
action.run: First line of a card where a socio (AI agent) asks to run an action in a mini app. {{action}} is the action's technical name (code). "Consequential" is a badge: the action has effects.
action.paramsHeading: Heading above the action's parameters (JSON). {{size}} is their size, such as "2.3 KB".
action.items: A count of items in a list inside the parameters. {{path}} is the list's path in the JSON (code).
action.params: Accessible name of the box showing the parameters (JSON).
action.showing: Under truncated parameters. {{shown}} and {{total}} are sizes, such as "4.0 KB". The pending variant also asks the person to open them all before allowing.
action.showAll: Button: loads and shows the full parameters.
action.described: Accessible name of the section where the mini app describes the action in its own words.
size.kb: A size in kilobytes (1 KB = 1024 bytes), with one decimal.
grant.removedApp: Stands in for a mini app's name once the app was removed.
grant.thisApp: Stands in for a mini app's name in grant.endTitle when it's unknown.
grant.end: Button: ends a socio's (AI agent's) access to a mini app at once.
grant.endLabel: Accessible name of the End access button. {{socio}}: the socio's (AI agent's) name; {{app}}: the mini app; {{person}} (admin view): whose access it is.
grant.from: Line under a granted access. {{socio}}: the socio's (AI agent's) name; {{place}}: one of grant.place. The person variant (admin view) starts with whose access it is.
grant.task: The task the socio (AI agent) gave when it asked, quoted. Use your language's quotation marks.
grant.when: A date and time in a granted access's history.
grant.since: When the access was granted; the tag is the date and time.
grant.live: History of a live access; each tag is a date and time. {{count}} is how many idle minutes end it.
grant.ended: History of an ended access; each tag is a date and time. {{reason}} is why it ended, from the server.
grant.endTitle: Title of the confirmation before ending an access. {{socio}}: the socio's (AI agent's) name; {{app}}: the mini app.
grant.endBody: Body of the confirmation before ending an access: what ending it does.
agents.unverified: Badge for a connected external agent (such as Claude Code) whose app has no verified domain.
access.verb.read: Completes "wants to … <app>" on a request card: what the socio (AI agent) wants to do in the mini app.
access.verb.write: Completes "wants to … <app>" on a request card: what the socio (AI agent) wants to do in the mini app.
access.verb.act: Completes "wants to … <app>" on a request card: what the socio (AI agent) wants to do in the mini app.
action.openFailed: Error on a request card in the chat when the full parameters can't be loaded.
action.describedLead: Lead-in above the mini app's own description of the action, on a request card in the chat.
size.bytes: A size in bytes, for small parameters on a request card.
grant.access.read: Badge on a granted access: the socio (AI agent) may only read the mini app.
grant.access.write: Badge on a granted access: the socio (AI agent) may read and change the mini app's data.
grant.access.act: Badge on a granted access: what the socio (AI agent) may do in the mini app.
grant.access.other: Badge on a granted access of a kind not listed here.
grant.place.room: Where the access was granted, inserted into grant.from. {{title}} is the chat's or room's title.
grant.place.roomUntitled: Where the access was granted, inserted into grant.from: a Room (group chat) with no title.
grant.place.chat: Where the access was granted, inserted into grant.from. {{title}} is the chat's or room's title.
grant.place.schedule: Where the access was granted, inserted into grant.from: a scheduled task.
grant.place.chatUntitled: Where the access was granted, inserted into grant.from: a private chat with no title.
